# Febhouse

> Febhouse is an architectural design studio and software developer creating specialized tools and resources for architects. Founded by architect Nam Nguyen.

## Products & Services
- **Architecture Projects**: Eco-resorts, homestays, townhouses, and villas.
- **Architecture Tools**: Professional SketchUp extensions including Sun Diagram, Dynamic Symbols, and Shadow Slice.
- **Custom Diagram Service**: Professional solar and site analysis service to help validate design impacts.
